title: Did You Eat? (밥 먹었니?) by Zoë Kim #didyoueat #zoëkim #mayitheatercompa...
transcript: Did You Eat? by Zoë Kim is an autobiographical tapestry of memories and realizations from her rocky road to love. The story starts before she was even born, as she explains the love her parents had intended for a son. They ended up having a daughter instead, and thus began Zoë's harrowing journey of surviving a love that felt like hate much of the time. She also touches on struggles with identity, cultural expectations, and immigrating to the US. I found the piece to be very insightful and unlike a lot of other autobiographical solo shows in that its second-person delivery reads simultaneously like a confessional and an act of self assurance. The fluid physicality and the cozy aesthetic of the production almost makes you feel like you're watching an animation. Though the story being told is harsh and heavy, Zoë curates a soft place for it to land, as if she's writing back to her inner child. We internalize the kind of love we receive, and while others can't always speak the love languages that we need to hear, it's never too late for us to do that for ourselves. Ma-Yi Theater Company is presenting Did You Eat? at The Public through November 16th. With that, another Playbill for my collection.
